baseline_token_stream_guard.policy: Baseline motif stream must decode to the original r0_delta chunk token stream before C3 side-stream substitution.

reconstruction_guard.policy: C3 hardening uses a two-stream representation: the baseline motif stream remains exact, and selected C3 tokens reconstruct the fallback-payload side-stream from prior same-chart fallback records. Flat main-stream contiguity is reported separately because fallback-substream spans can skip motif-covered groups.
